thread:
maria_cs: Morning — noticed overnight that a subset of EU onboarding imports (S3->index jobs) failed for 7 high-touch customers. They started around 02:14 UTC and retried but hit a consistent 500 on our ingest lambda. I tagged the list in the ticket.
kevin_eng: ack, digging in. seeing repeated errors in the lambda logs: `NullPointerException` in the transform step for payloads with missing metadata.field_x. will post logs in a sec.
maria_cs: thanks. these are mostly customers in active trial/renewal windows — want to get a proactive comm out before AM. can we confirm root cause and ETA for a fix?
kevin_eng: root cause looks like a recent change in the import schema validation (rolled last night) that tightened requirement for metadata.field_x. regression slipped past unit tests. temporary mitigation: revert the validation or coerce missing field to default. i can push a hotfix revert in the next 45m.
lara_se: i'll draft the customer note for the 7 affected accounts. low-friction tone, acknowledgement + ETA + offer live troubleshooting and credits. sharing a quick template below — feel free to edit: 

maria_cs: shared template is great — add an explicit call-to-action for a 1:1 enablement slot and a link to our onboarding guide. also confirm whether their data is at risk (i.e., duplicates/partial writes).
kevin_eng: no data loss; writes were blocked and failed. nothing partial made it to index. i'll include that assurance in the comms.
tom_cust: can we offer a 2-hour window for hands-on migration help? a few of these tenants were scheduled for go-live next week.
lara_se: yes — proposing a 2-hour office hours slot (Tue 14:00-16:00 CET) and offer priority booking. drafting: 

---
Hi {{first_name}} —
I’m reaching from Redwood Inference Support. We ran into a problem last night that impacted your onboarding import. The issue was caused by a schema validation change; imports were halted and failed with a server error.
What we’re doing: we’ll roll a hotfix to restore imports within ~45 minutes and then re-run your failed jobs. No data was lost; failed jobs did not index.
What you can expect: a follow-up when your import completes, and an option to schedule a priority 1:1 migration help session.
Compensation: we’re offering a one-time credit equivalent to the import job cost, and a 30-minute enablement session.
If you’d like immediate help, book here: https://redwood.example.com/office-hours
Thanks for your patience — maria on behalf of the team
---

maria_cs: love it. change "30-minute" to "60-minute" for these high-touch customers and call out the EU region.
lara_se: updated. adding a short bulleted FAQ and an opt-in for the priority slot.
ops_bot: Incident tag created: INC-2026-345. Notified on-call.
kevin_eng: hotfix deployed at 03:01 UTC (reverted strict validation). re-triggering failed imports now. i’ll monitor and post status.
kevin_eng: imports re-run started at 03:07 UTC. 5/7 completed successfully, 2 still queued due to rate limiting — clearing backlog now.
maria_cs: perfect. lara — can you send the comms to the 7 customers with the updated template and include the booking link + proposed office hours? i'll add the credit manually after confirmation.
lara_se: sending now. copying draft here: "Hi Alex — quick update: we identified and fixed an import validation issue for EU customers, your import will re-run and we expect completion within 1 hour. We’ve booked a priority enablement slot if you want hands-on assistance. Credits will be applied after verification. — Maria from Redwood"
tom_cust: pls include how they can opt-out of the re-run if they prefer manual control.
lara_se: updated — added opt-out instructions and a reply-to for scheduling. sent to all 7.
kevin_eng: final status: all 7 imports completed at 03:48 UTC. verified no duplicates, indices healthy. logs: https://intra.redwood/logs/INC-2026-345 (internal).
maria_cs: thanks team. next steps: 1) cs follow-up thread to track who booked enablement and credits applied (lara + tom). 2) eng to add a unit/integration test for optional metadata.field_x. 3) postmortem draft due EOD and share with affected account execs.
lara_se: capturing follow-ups in the ticket and adding customers to priority office hours RSVP.
kevin_eng: i'll own the test and CI change, cc-ing infra.
maria_cs: quick retrospec note for postmortem: include detection gap (validation tightened without end-to-end smoke), comm timing, and proposed automated rollback guard for schema changes.
tom_cust: thanks — i'll loop in renewals for the three accounts with upcoming renewals and offer extended trial if needed.
maria_cs: closing the loop here. great job. :clap:
